hooks.name: Link task to requirements (IDE)
hooks.description: Before a spec task starts, name the requirement and property IDs it satisfies and any [SAFETY] requirement it touches.

action.prompt: Before starting this task, list the requirement IDs (R..), correctness property IDs (P..) and any [SAFETY] requirements it touches, from requirements.md and design.md. If none apply, stop and ask the owner to update the spec.
